Blue means the club said it. Pink means only the papers did.

CONFIRMED — Inter have won on each of their last four visits to Bergamo, and seven of their last eight league games against Atalanta, drawing the other; Fabio Maresca referees, and Francesco Pio Esposito has scored in each of his last four games for Inter and Italy. Source: Inter.it match guide, Nov 20.
REPORTED — The squad trains Saturday at Appiano Gentile and leaves for Bergamo only on Sunday; a choice in midfield between Petar Sučić and Henrikh Mkhitaryan, with Pio Esposito and Marcus Thuram expected up front. Source: Sky Sport Italia via FCInterNews, Nov 20.
CONFIRMED — The Lombardy sports journalists' association, GLGS-USSI Lombardia, named Inter its team of the year, shared with Como. Source: Inter.it, Nov 20.
CONFIRMED — Inter Women visit Ternana on Sunday at 6:30 AM ET in the women's Serie A. Source: Inter.it, Nov 21.
NEXT UP — Atalanta vs Inter, Sunday, Nov 22, 2:45 PM ET (20:45 CET), Serie A Matchday 12. US TV: Paramount+.
